sourceReview.inclusionRule: KEEP only plus positive resolution to a galaxy or interacting-galaxy system; non-galaxy imagery removed
sourceReview.duplicatePolicy: Multiple approved images of the same physical galaxy remain separate image records and share resolved target metadata.

metadataPolicy.targetResolution: Physical targets resolved before metadata assignment; generic SSC/SIG release IDs are not used as galaxy names.
metadataPolicy.coordinates: Prefer S4G/CS4G target coordinates for S4G galaxies; official Spitzer or NASA/ESA target/image astrometry overrides when more directly applicable; Hubble 0018 supplies cross-check/fallback.
metadataPolicy.distance: Prefer S4G/CS4G redshift-independent distances where available; otherwise use official Spitzer/Hubble published distances.
metadataPolicy.age: age is a Hubble-compatible light-travel/lookback display estimate derived from the published light-travel distance; it is not the stellar population age of the galaxy.
metadataPolicy.size: Prefer CS4G physical size; otherwise preserve/derive the Hubble-compatible image-footprint estimate from sourced angular field and published distance. Estimated values are labeled EST.
metadataPolicy.navigation: Prefer full-galaxy S4G angular diameter and position angle where available. Official Spitzer astrometry/FOV/orientation is used for special targets and cases with superior image metadata.
metadataPolicy.credit: Exact official image credit is used when harvested. Otherwise the record carries an explicit NASA/JPL-Caltech Spitzer-gallery provider attribution marked creditExact=false rather than inventing individual contributors.
metadataPolicy.hudfJd2Repair: The Spitzer gallery record ssc2005-19a2 publishes invalid 0.0 x 0.0 FOV and inconsistent target astrometry. 0008 uses the corresponding ESA/Hubble HUDF-JD2 blow-up astrometry/FOV/orientation and retains the Spitzer/NASA published distance/redshift.

optionalFieldSemantics.assetName_bytes_sha256_githubImageUrl_re: Null because Spitzer assets are referenced remotely and were not mirrored into a Galaxy Viewer GitHub release; these fields are not used for remote HD loading.
optionalFieldSemantics.pixelSize: Null where exact source pixel dimensions were not independently harvested; no dimensions are inferred.
optionalFieldSemantics.releaseDate: Populated only where an exact release date was recovered from official metadata; archive-ID year is not promoted to a fabricated date.
optionalFieldSemantics.astroPixSourceUrl: Populated only for records actually sourced through AstroPix.
optionalFieldSemantics.esaPublicationJpeg: Not applicable to the Spitzer provider and therefore null.
optionalFieldSemantics.ageMinGyr_ageMaxGyr: Null because source-specific stellar-age uncertainty intervals are not available; ageGyr is the explicitly labeled lookback-display quantity.
optionalFieldSemantics.spitzerTargetReference: Populated for S4G/CS4G-mapped targets; null for valid targets without that specific cross-reference.
optionalFieldSemantics.sizeCosmology: Populated only for the two high-redshift records whose physical image footprint requires angular-diameter-distance cosmology.

scientificIntegrity.orientationNormalization: Archive orientation angles are stored canonically within 0-360 degrees; 0008 wrapped values were normalized without changing direction.
scientificIntegrity.highRedshiftSizeMethod: For z>0.1, image-footprint physical size uses flat Lambda-CDM angular-diameter distance (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7), not light-travel distance.
scientificIntegrity.provenanceCompletion: All 70 retained entries carry explicit distance, age-display, size, and redshift methods; redshift is retained from source where available or explicitly marked estimated when inverted from the catalog lookback display.

repairExceptions.issue: Spitzer gallery ssc2005-19a2 publishes 0.0 x 0.0 FOV and inconsistent astrometry.
repairExceptions.resolution: Use ESA/Hubble heic0513c matching HUDF-JD2 blow-up for astrometry, 0.64 x 0.64 arcmin FOV, and orientation; retain Spitzer/NASA distance/redshift.
